metadata.title: An Army Officer’s Martial Law Survival Guide
metadata.author: Ferguson Mason
metadata.publisher_notice: Global Brother SRL copyright 2026. Printed byline Ferguson Mason. PDF metadata author Ioana Andreea Neamtu.
metadata.page_mapping: PDF 1 is the unnumbered cover. From PDF 2, printed page equals PDF page minus 1.

methodology.record_unit: Consequential claim or closely related claims.

classifications.verified_guidance: Narrow principle supported by reviewed evidence.
classifications.source_derived_reference: Source context or planning candidate with limited independent support.
classifications.needs_review: Unsupported, unsafe, incomplete or corrected claim.

limitations: Records group consequential claims and do not enumerate every assertion. Source claims are paraphrased. No raw source components are bundled.
The cover is unnumbered. Body labels take precedence over the contents. Section labels are editorial descriptors.
The printed byline and professional credentials are unauthenticated.
Topic and milestone associations are research metadata. All records remain execution-held.
The review does not adjudicate any particular encounter. Tactical evasion and weapons instructions are omitted.

record.title: Powers and duties of Governor
record.finding: Virginia specifies emergency powers and conditions. The operative order and jurisdiction determine actual restrictions.

record.title: Ex parte Milligan
record.finding: The ruling addresses military trial of a civilian where civil courts were open.

record.title: Making Water Safe in an Emergency
record.locator: Making Water Safe in an Emergency
record.finding: Boiling or disinfection cannot make water contaminated by fuels or toxic chemicals safe.

record.title: Carbon Monoxide Poisoning Basics
record.finding: Do not operate portable camping stoves indoors.

record.title: Preventing Hypothermia
record.finding: Warm layers help reduce cold exposure. Shivering and confusion are warning signs. Hypothermia is a medical emergency.

record.title: Declaration of local emergency
record.finding: Subsection C describes conditional local authority over specified commodities and retains mandatory constitutional requirements.

record.title: Military presence and panic
record.guidance: Identify the actual order, issuing agency, area and duration. Presence alone does not establish the operative legal restrictions.

record.title: Three-stage escalation model
record.guidance: Treat the stages as the author’s model. Actual powers and restrictions depend on the facts and legal authority.

record.title: Civil rights under military control
record.guidance: Emergency circumstances do not automatically suspend constitutional limits. Milligan addresses military trial where civil courts were open and does not decide every emergency encounter.

record.title: Checkpoint inspections and compliance
record.guidance: Procedures and legal scope vary. Verify the applicable order and seek case-specific legal advice for a disputed search.

record.title: Timing and routes through controlled areas
record.guidance: Use officially open routes and check restrictions before departure. Operational avoidance details are omitted.

record.title: Blending into local movement
record.guidance: Appearance does not establish permission to travel. No concealment procedure is approved.

record.title: Emergency seizure of supplies
record.guidance: Virginia law gives specified emergency powers over certain resources. Whether property can be taken and what remedies apply require the operative order and case-specific legal analysis.

record.title: Night movement under curfew
record.guidance: Use the actual order and published exemptions. The account supplies no standing permission to travel.

record.title: Weapons during detention
record.guidance: No weapons-handling instructions are reproduced. Follow lawful instructions and seek qualified advice about local requirements.

record.title: Transition out of restrictions
record.guidance: Check current official notices. Normal-looking activity cannot establish that restrictions have expired.

record.title: Refuge and route planning
record.guidance: Confirm legal access, current route status, destination capacity and communications. No concealed positioning instructions are reproduced.

record.title: Exits and transit
record.guidance: Confirm actual service and official restrictions. No route or mode is universally safe.

record.title: Water and shelter priorities
record.guidance: Water availability and potability are separate. CDC warns boiling or disinfection cannot make water containing fuel or toxic chemicals safe.

record.title: Concealment and fire
record.guidance: Fire and carbon monoxide hazards remain. Keep fuel-burning camping equipment outdoors and away from openings.

record.title: Emergency wild food
record.guidance: A brief field note cannot establish species identity, safe parts, preparation or contamination status.

record.title: Twilight and location security
record.guidance: Operational evasion details omitted. Legal access and actual safety remain unresolved.

record.title: Layers and wind exposure
record.guidance: Treat altered mental status or suspected hypothermia as an emergency. The source is not a validated clinical protocol.

record.title: Concealed weapons and equipment
record.guidance: No tactical advice is reproduced. Legal authorization and safe storage depend on actual circumstances.

record.title: Keeping weapons secure
record.guidance: An operational carry approach does not establish safe household storage.

record.title: Weapons, cover and engagement
record.guidance: Operational details omitted. The text supplies no legal justification for force or tested protective assembly.

record.title: Lethal-force directive
record.guidance: Reject as a blanket rule. A disaster guide cannot establish that force is lawful or necessary in a particular encounter.
